description: This file defines a data class 'GatewayEndpoint' representing a network gateway endpoint configuration, including properties like host, port, TLS options, and optional LAN/DNS details. It also provides a companion object with a utility method for creating manual gateway instances.

classes.name: GatewayEndpoint
classes.description: A Kotlin data class encapsulating configuration details for a network gateway endpoint, including identifiers, host info, port numbers, TLS settings, and optional LAN and DNS parameters.

methods.name: manual
methods.description: A companion object method that creates a GatewayEndpoint instance with specified host and port, assigning a generated stableId and defaulting TLS settings to disabled.
